rules.name: Fix the leaks first
rules.verdict: DEFERRED: a measure is deferred while a confirmed first-line stressor is not addressed by a first-line measure (plan-level: BLOCKED/INCOMPLETE)
rules.quote: It is like fixing the leaks in a bucket before trying to fill it.

rules.name: Parallel delivery where urban constraints require
rules.verdict: ALLOWED_BY_OVERRIDE: second-line measures may run in parallel with essential ones when a named approver records an urban constraint
rules.quote: implemented once essential conditions are secured or, where urban constraints require, in parallel as part of an integrated delivery strategy

rules.name: Barrier exception
rules.verdict: INDICATED: where barriers are the dominant limiting factor, removal or fish passage is not deferred behind first-line measures
rules.quote: Barrier removal to restore longitudinal connectivity, or the implementation of fish passages in systems where barriers constitute the dominant limiting factor; in such cases, improving longitudinal connectivity becomes essential and should be prioritised at early stages of rehabilitation

rules.name: Symptom only: invasive species control
rules.verdict: SYMPTOM_ONLY: invasive control alone does not succeed unless system-level stressors are managed first
rules.quote: otherwise, invasives simply recolonize the restored sites.

rules.name: Compensatory measures are a last resort
rules.verdict: CONTRAINDICATED unless the officer records why lines 1-3 are infeasible here
rules.quote: compensatory measures should be regarded as options of last resort, to be implemented only when it is not possible to restore or re-establish self-sustaining ecological resilience and natural processes that support long-term river recovery

rules.name: A package, not a single measure
rules.verdict: INCOMPLETE: multiple problems need a package of hierarchical measures, not one measure alone
rules.quote: They also stress that multiple problems require a package of hierarchical measures, it is not enough to just reshape the channel, nor is it enough to only plant trees.

rules.name: SMART objectives
rules.verdict: INCOMPLETE: each placed measure needs a specific, measurable, time-bound objective
rules.quote: Once restoration targets are established, they should be translated into clear SMART objectives, Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Realistic, and Time-bound, explicitly linked to project goals and expected outcomes.

rules.name: Respect the response lag
rules.verdict: NOT_YET_KNOWABLE: no outcome verdict before the expected response time of the indicator has elapsed
rules.quote: The frequency and duration of monitoring should align with the life histories of the target organisms and the expected timescale of their responses (i.e., the lag period)

rules.name: Controls and before-after design
rules.verdict: CONFOUNDED: without an appropriate control, a change cannot be attributed to the restoration
rules.quote: Without appropriate controls, it becomes difficult to determine whether observed changes result from restoration activities or from broader environmental variation.

cite.quote: During the early establishment phase (typically the first 2–3 years), bio-engineered structures and newly restored banks are still integrating into this dynamic system.
